body:
Approved spec: .adlc/specs/SC-019-v21-wizard-real-offers.md (v2.1, builds on SC-014). Do not edit the specs. Do not call Gemini or any live API in tests. Do not commit secrets, personal data, or the e-bill PDFs. Money is integer LKR. A percent discount is (amount * rate_bps) // 10000. Hard cut-off 17:00 Colombo 18 Oct 2026 (assumption C8).

Mock partner endpoints (spec in-scope item 10).
src/savvycart/partners.py: an APIRouter with GET /mock/stores, GET /mock/stores/{store_id}/catalog (prices and promotions for that store), GET /mock/banks, GET /mock/banks/{bank_id}/offers. Every response has mock true and the data label and is built from fixtures/v2 (the files the engine reads). Unknown ids return 404. http.py includes the router (one line).

Acceptance criteria:
1. Mock endpoints serve the engine fixtures. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_mock_partners.py::test_mock_partner_endpoints_serve_the_engine_fixtures -q
2. Every test passes. Verify: python -m pytest -q
title: v2.1 mock partner endpoints for stores and banks
